title: Change the payment details on an E-Toll Account
summary: You can change the payment details on your E-Toll account online or by submitting a form.
intro:
You can change the credit card or debit card information on a Transport for NSW E-Toll account online.

To change direct debit details, you can send a direct debit request form by post or email, or visit a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: Be the account holder or an additional contact.
what_you_need: The changed credit or debit card details
The 'Direct Debit Request' PDF form (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: Log in to your E-Toll Account.
Download the Direct Debit Request – PDF.
Send by post or email using the details on the form, or take to a service centre.

internal_links.text: Change the customer details on a personal E-Toll Account
Change the customer details on a business E-Toll Account

faqs.q: How can I change my payment details?
faqs.a: You can change your credit or debit card information online. To change direct debit details, you must send a direct debit request form by post or email, or visit a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: Who can change the payment details?
faqs.a: You must be the account holder or an additional contact to make this change.

faqs.q: What do I need to change my payment details?
faqs.a: You need your E-Toll account details, the changed credit or debit card details, and the 'Direct Debit Request' PDF form if applicable.
